geometry.notes: Standard configuration (no magneto-optic, no 1.2 K OneK-Optic, no nanopositioner). Sample-space height conflict: QD Europe datasheet says 53 x 63 mm inside the radiation shield; Montana's US brochure says Ø53mm x 116mm - the catalog uses 63 mm. Stage temperatures 27-28 K / 2.4-2.7 K are the manual's 'example' base-temperature table for a standard CryoAdvance-50, with the platform spec of <3.2 K; the sample lags Stage 1 by ~100 K during cooldown. Working distance: horizontal >25.3 mm, vertical >8.8 mm; acceptance angle 60 deg full. Heat load if a cold window is removed: 50-100 mW per window. Cooling power 130 mW at 4.2 K; cooldown ~2 h; vibration <5 nm p-p. GM cryocooler is suspended in the cooling tower with a vibration-damping support and a semi-rigid bellows to the sample chamber; whole assembly bolts to the optical table at 45 or 90 deg. geometry.notes: Vertical stainless-steel vapour-phase LN2 freezer, not a cryostat: no vacuum sample space, no windows, no sample wiring, no magnet. Scene = 1618 mm tall cylinder (inner vessel 1422 mm dia; outer shell slightly larger, unpublished) with 635 mm neck and hinged lid at the 985 mm liftover line, 54 large + 30 mini square racks (13 shelves) standing on a vapour platform above a 292 L LN2 pool; enclosed plumbing/electronics work surface with TEC 3000 or touch screen; two-tier folding step. Only moving things: hinged lid, manual turn tray, solenoid-controlled LN2 fill and lid-vented boil-off. Catalog document list points at the labrepco mirror of the same ML-000019 Rev 0 spec sheet; URLs here are the mvebio.com originals verified in research/v5/cache (0d5eb2789a332582, 13289499-R, CryoVerse manual). geometry.notes: Single source: 800 Series Cryostream Operating and Instruction Guide, Oxford Cryosystems 2014 (SFU mirror), text cached at research/v5/cache/4dfb8bc9e86001d6.txt (65 pages). Cryostream Plus differs from the standard only by its 500 K upper limit (Section 5.1); all geometry is identical. Physical layout from the manual: coldhead with integral vacuum-insulated transfer line (1500 mm flexible + 905 mm rigid leg, min bend radius 200 mm, ~900 mm leg uses top 850 mm of dewar) plunged into the unpressurised 60 L ES60 dewar (NW50 KF neck, 50 mm bore); coldhead clamped in the Varibeam stand with fine X/Y/Z translation; red 6 mm PTFE dry-air tube to the coldhead; 3.5 m Coldhead Cable to the controller (placed < 3 m from coldhead, < 2 m from the gas pump). Vacuum space re-pumped every 12-18 months via the pump-out adaptor (NW16/KF16) with the CRH25 re-activation heater. Nothing moves in the coldhead itself: the only motion is the N2 gas flow driven by the separate gas pump, the dry-air shroud, and LN2 consumption/boil-off from the dewar. 'outer' uses the Varibeam stand envelope (600 mm height, 430 mm reach) because the coldhead body has no published dimensions. geometry.notes: Sources: Optistat DN-V Operators Manual Issue 2.0 (fetched 2026-10-31, text cached at research/v5/cache/cc66df633f2a016a.txt; robots.txt blocked the snapshot script so the PDF was fetched with WebFetch and text-extracted); Optistat family brochure (research/v5/cache/c73e273061693731.txt); QD-Oxford product page (research/v5/cache/295cbbaf14723ca3.txt) which also states 'Weight: 5 kg', '35 mm diameter window aperture', 'System Cooldown: ~ 20 Minutes to 77 K'. Standard config: 4 radial Spectrosil WF windows + 1 axial blank, f/1.0, 10 DC wires (order code 100); optional 2 coax (code 002) not included. OVC pumped by customer pump via DN16NW port to <1e-4 mbar then held by charcoal sorb; no mechanical cooler, no moving cold head; the only motion is LN2 boil-off vapour from the exhaust valve and gravity-fed LN2 capillary flow. 500 K operation requires sapphire windows.

geometry.notes: Compact tabletop LN2 bath optical cryostat, 175 x 175 x 450 mm, 5 kg (manual Table 3-5 and 7.3). Top: LN2 fill/vent pipe, nitrogen exhaust flow needle valve, two 10-pin connectors (diagnostic, experimental) on the OVC top plate, DN16NW OVC evacuation port with pressure-relief plates. Inside: 1.2 L LN2 reservoir around a central heat-exchanger support tube; capillary feeds a gravity-fed heat exchanger carrying heater + PT100; sample holder (20 x 50 mm) bolts beneath, sample in vacuum ('No cold windows', no radiation-shield windows). Four radial Spectrosil WF windows + one axial blank, each held by four nylon screws and an O-ring, 35 mm clear aperture, f/1 (QD Oxford page: 'Large illumination area: 35 mm diameter window aperture'; 'Weight: 5 kg'). Charcoal sorb with 150 ohm heater on the reservoir keeps the OVC below 1e-4 mbar. 77.2-500 K, +/-0.1 K, cooldown 20 min, hold >= 15 h. No cryocooler, no magnet; only motion is LN2 boil-off vapour at the vent and the optional external pump. Sources: QD Oxford Optistat matrix PDF (OPTSS 0926 R5, cache c73e273061693731), QD Oxford product page https://www.qd-oxford.com/products/optistat_spectroscopy.html (cache 295cbbaf14723ca3), Oxford Instruments Optistat family brochure (cache d52046bdb551703d), Oxford Instruments Optistat DN-V Operators Manual Issue 2.0 Dec 2020 (andor.oxinst.com robots.txt disallows the snapshot script; PDF fetched via WebFetch and text extracted locally with pypdf into the session scratchpad).

Stage stack per the Proteox high-temperature app note: stainless top plate (vacuum enclosure) -> PT1 -> PT2 -> still -> cold plate -> mixing chamber, with gas-gap heat switches and a remote sorption pump weakly coupled to PT2. Line of sight: 2 x Secondary Insert (117 x 252 mm) + 4 x KF25. This configuration (ISO100-2 SI, no magnet, no windows) has no optical windows and no bottom loader. Helium-3 requirement for LX is 50 L per the family brochure table (qd-oxford.com/siteDocs/The_Proteox_Family_Brochure.pdf). PT1/still/cold-plate temperatures come from the QSHS axion paper (arXiv 2504.12257) describing a Proteox MX500 and are flagged as sibling-platform data.

geometry.notes: Scene: vertical aluminium OVC of stacked cylindrical sections on a cross-braced steel frame; inside, top plate -> PT1 (77 K) -> PT2 (4 K copper shield, magnet hangs from it) -> still (700 mK shield) -> cold plate (100 mK) -> 360 mm mixing chamber plate (< 10 mK; MX450 guaranteed > 450 uW at 100 mK, > 12 uW at 20 mK). One Sumitomo RP-182B2S pulse tube (PTR options 1.35/1.50/1.80 W; 1.5 W = RP-182B2S) with separated valve unit. One 117 x 252 mm Secondary Insert slot carries the BLL-72 bottom-loader SI with cold finger: 28 SMA hermetic + 4 x 24-way Fischer at room temperature, 28 SMP + 2 x 51-way Nano-D at the cold finger, plus one spare ISO100 LOS port (up to 37 coax). The 72 mm x 144 mm puck enters from below through a vacuum lock on a removable loading arm; load < 15 min, 10 h cooldown, < 12 mK and 150 uW at 100 mK at the puck. 14 T solenoid, quench protected, ramps to full field in 1 h or less; patented gas-gap heat switches with a remote sorb (outgassed at ~30 K) link the plates. Also 2 x KF40 + 2 x KF25 LOS ports on the top plate. CAVEATS: PT1/PT2/still/cold-plate temperatures and the 2 m x 0.6 m outer size come from the published Sheffield QSHS Proteox MX500 (8 T custom magnet), the closest documented Proteox MX, not an MX450 datasheet. The catalog unknown stands: the 14 T + 72 mm / 28-coax pairing is 'Dependent on magnet selection' and undocumented; the BLL-60 (77 mm bore, 22 coax, 96 DC) may be the actual 14 T puck. A Pisa MX450 (no magnet) is wired with 7 coax, 2 x 24-wire DC looms and 2 single-mode fibres (cisup.unipi.it/?p=5370), a different real-world wiring.

geometry.notes: Horizontal front-loading box: 125.2 cm W x 55.1 cm H x 61 cm D (add 7.1 cm F-B for utilities and door handle), 87 kg unpacked, freestanding, powder-coated 304 stainless steel. Interior 48.3 x 30.5 x 33 cm, 48 L. One front door opening left to right with T-handle high-compression latch; foamed-in-place polyurethane insulation with Teflon heat breaks. Cooling: LN2 injected through an injection ring via dual solenoid valves from a 22 psi (1.5 bar) low-pressure supply tank via a 6 ft braided stainless hose with 0.5 in 45-degree flare connectors (LN2 inlet on the back, per drawing labels LN2 INLET, POWER PLUG, REMOTE ALARM CONTACT, RS232/PC INTERFACE). Heating: 945 W 115 V tubular heater. Rates 0.1-99.9 C/min cooling, 0.1-10 C/min warming, +50 to -180 C. Air-handling system circulates chamber air (fan implied, speed not published). Touch-screen LCD on the front, no thermal printer on XV. Type T thermocouples for chamber and sample. Catalog 'Compressor: Air-cooled' on the product page is a web attribute conflicting with the LN2-injection design and is not modelled.
